verdict_rule.insufficient: none not met, but any no data
verdict_rule.never_a_criterion: Safety and toxicity rings, druggability rings, clinical stage, drug count and literature volume. Puck, 2026-10-18: "no toxicity data or low druggability does not exclude. this could be fixed by consulting a chemist." They print as a caveat line under the verdict, never as an exclusion.

accounts.purpose: LLM triage of the top 10 genes (not built; nothing has ever been spent on it)
the phenotype-page summary, one call per gene, summarising only the table it sits above
the contrast chooser, one call per disease, choosing only among contrasts the index already offered it
the region chooser, one call per disease and then cached, choosing only among the GTEx tissues this build can read
the per-gene evidence summary, baked offline by scripts/bake_summaries.py from the gene's own drawer values and served as a file; the app never makes this call

spend.note: No paid call is on the render path: the figure draws without a key. Each account has its own cap and none borrows from another. Model prices change, so read these as what this project had cost by the date above, not as a price list.

no_ranking: There is no score, no weighted sum, no front and no ranking of any kind (AGENTS.md rule 7). The spoke order is a decision, it is stated on the figure, and it is checked in the artefact. The rings are evidence for a reader to weigh.
